## Summary

```text
Stage → tank/projectile → part/attachment → nested leaf
  carry the full inverse linear matrix
  local stroke width = max(authored width, inverse column lengths)
  keep declared bounds rejection and round geometric caps/joins
```

Corrects positive thin strokes at reduced scales, including game zoom. Creator selection and retained/stateless projectile contact use the same transform calculation. CSS/DPR scaling stays outside this geometry contract.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the new browser regression misses four expected thin-stroke hits at full scale, half scale, nested unequal scaling and reflection.
  **After:** those hits pass alongside misses/bounds, enlarged widths, singular transforms, endpoint distance, rotated/scaled tank parts, game zoom and retained/stateless projectile checks.
- Pinned Ruffle source and controlled replay corroborate the width calculation. `hit-test-probe.py --thin-strokes` reproduces the recorded 1220-byte SHA256; the default 970-byte payload is unchanged. No SWFs or artwork committed. Adobe behavior and exact twip/boundary semantics remain explicit limits.
- `bun run format`, `bun run check`: 417 tests, 5543 assertions. Production build passes. 54 broad browser cases pass; after isolating cached synthetic fixture data, a fresh build and all six contact/native creator cases pass. Full validation scope and remaining limits are recorded in the fidelity ledger.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** collision

May change projectile interception near thin contours. Painted artwork is unchanged; geometry stays within declared leaf bounds.
